paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Abba of Hagronia.

Bava Kamma 88a relates that his mother married Rabbi Abba. She assigned her property to her son Rav Shmuel (whom Hyman identifies as her son from her first husband, Rabbi Abba of Hagronia) and died. Rav Shmuel went to Rav Yirmeyah bar Abba, who established his right to the property. Rabbi Abba reported the matter to Rav Hoshaya, who reported it to Rav Yehudah; he ruled that the property belonged to Rabbi Abba.
He also asked Rabbi Abba a question in Bava Kamma 6b.

notes.text: The mother’s first husband and later husband are both named Abba in Hyman’s account; they are not merged. The case begins on 88a and continues on 88b.
